{{Quote|Earlier today I received a distress call from Seren ― from Agent Song ― broadcast from Lotho Minor. A naked call for help, sent over a commercial HoloNet carrier... and using ''my'' name.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Star Wars 19" />}}
The '''mission to Lotho Minor''' was undertaken by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
